sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Eccleshall at Sandbach Community Football Centre on Saturday, looking to extend their impressive form. The Ramblers claimed a 2-0 victory over Eccleshall in the fixture that has already been played this week, with goals from Josh Fowles and Kyle Foley securing the points despite playing the second half with ten men after Robbie Hatton's sin bin.
divisionWide: In other Saturday fixtures, second-placed Stafford Town drew 3-3 at home against Cheadle Heath Nomads in a dramatic encounter where Town rallied from going down to ten men late in the second half, with Mazurkiewicz equalising in the 83rd minute. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth suffered a surprise 1-0 defeat away at Brereton Social, who scored an own goal in the 26th minute. Wolverhampton Casuals climbed the table with a convincing 3-1 away victory at Shawbury United. Bilston Town thrashed Market Drayton Town 3-0 at home after Drayton went down to ten men early on. Allscott Heath secured four goals in a 4-1 home rout of bottom-club Alsager Town. Barnton earned an impressive 2-0 away win at Telford Town to maintain their unbeaten league run. Crewe travelled to Wednesfield Community, who won 1-0 courtesy of Rio Tetsell's goal for their first clean sheet of the season. New Mills fell 2-1 at home to Dawley Town, who battled back from a goal down in what the visitors described as a gritty performance.
